as_told.title: Minot AFB bomber encounters a saucer
as_told.place_text: Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a 1968 incident at Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota, where something unexplained is said to have been seen. Michels says that, unusually, there is radar data from the event, and that physicists, including one named Kevin Knuth, have looked it over. He brings it up because radar backing would make the sighting harder to put down to people's eyes playing tricks.
